All fields need to be on the left hand side of each condition (for example: `user_list_id = 123`). Fields must be specified using either all [camel case](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camel_case) or all [snake case](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snake_case). Don't use a combination of camel case and snake case. **Supported Operations:** - `AND` - `=` - `!=` - `>` - `>=` - `<` - `<=` **Supported Functions:** - `IN(field, value1, value2, ...)`: returns true if the field matches any of the values.
